newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish court rules against Islamic headscarves.
newsitem.headline: Turkish court rules against Islamic headscarves.

text.p: A Turkish court on Friday overruled an attempt by the Islamist justice minister to allow female lawyers to wear Islamic headscarves in court, Anatolian news agency said.
It said the Council of State, Turkey's highest administrative body, ruled an order by Justice Minister Sevket Kazan that headscarves could be worn was not valid.
Wearing Islamic head gear in many walks of public life is forbidden under Turkey's strict secularist system.
The military has called for a reversal of a relaxation of restrictions on Islamic dress as part of a proposed crackdown on Islamist activism.
Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan Islamist-led government has shown few signs of complying with the army's wishes.
